name: EPIC 210721309
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 23.2 solar radii and 1.32 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210721309 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 23.214782 (16th-84th percentiles 21.463849-25.105621), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210721309 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3295.273438 (16th-84th percentiles 3111.015625-3489.492188), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,295 parsecs away, 23 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.32 solar masses and 23.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,433 K at its surface.
